stage: Frozen before any context/holdout embedding measurement

protocol.text: label + ". " + exact Russian ontology comment; shared definition per actual entity IRI
protocol.embedding_inputs: Only left/right; no pair ID, expected label, category or score is embedded
protocol.labels: Original 20 labels and phrases preserved; all 20 pairs embedding-scored without category skips
protocol.categories: Taken from actual OWL entity type; cross-category negative pairs remain scored
protocol.threshold: Try 0.90; if errors, choose midpoint of nonempty separating interval; otherwise report blocker
protocol.holdout: 20 additional balanced pairs with disjoint concept IRIs; fixed calibration threshold, no tuning
protocol.no_adaptation: Do not rewrite definitions, remove pairs, or relabel after scores; retain every measured attempt
protocol.limitations: Ontology-grounded semisynthetic definitions; synonyms share comments; holdout shares construction method and is not independent human validation
protocol.acceptance: No success assumed; T04 still requires zero errors on mandatory pairs and >=70% valid first responses
